stumbles.quote: Lock screen rotation in portrait. The game asks you to turn the phone to landscape itself when it needs it.
stumbles.why: Unclear how the game can make you turn to landscape if rotation is locked; it's also unclear whether the game rotates the display itself or just prompts you. It seems to conflict with step 4's 'turn the phone to landscape'.

stumbles.quote: Turn the phone to landscape when the prompt asks you to, and hold it the way you want to drive.
stumbles.why: Unclear which landscape direction to use, or what 'the way you want to drive' means. It also doesn't say whether the screen will rotate with rotation locked.

stumbles.quote: the game takes the phone's tilt at that moment as straight ahead
stumbles.why: Unclear whether this calibration applies only to steering or also to accelerate/brake neutral. It's also unclear what 'steady' means for the pitch angle.

stumbles.quote: It needs a phone with a motion sensor.
stumbles.why: Doesn't say whether Android needs permission, or what happens on a desktop browser. Vague, though minor.

point: Open the page on a phone, allow motion access, pick track, laps and difficulty in portrait, switch to landscape, keep the phone steady through the start lights, then tilt to steer, accelerate and brake.
